verdict.rationale: Tilled documents a public API with API keys, a quick-start guide, sandbox/test environment, and webhooks for event-driven use, indicating the product can be driven programmatically (tilled-docs-1, tilled-docs-2, tilled-docs-3, tilled-docs-4). However, the evidence pack lacks a full API reference/spec, SDK details, or independent developer corroboration of building an integration end-to-end. Missing for 10: comprehensive API reference/OpenAPI docs, SDK examples, and third-party/hands-on confirmation of programmatic control.
